feature_preprocessing.all_missing_training_feature: keep feature; impute zero as technical fallback
feature_preprocessing.fit_scope: training rows with finite target only, within each fold

target_policy: exclude missing/nonfinite targets separately; never impute outcomes

metrics.mae: pooled held-out pitch mean absolute error
metrics.rmse: pooled held-out pitch root mean squared error
metrics.r2: pooled held-out R²; undefined for fewer than two or constant observations
metrics.athlete_mae: unweighted mean of per-athlete held-out MAE

excluded_predictors: both outcome columns, including duplicated metadata pitch speed
interpretation: Same-pitch post-motion descriptive associations, not pre-pitch forecasts. Joint moment is not an injury probability or a validated injury predictor. No causal inference or synchronized video availability is assumed.
